neighbours.label: the second subword piece of a capitalised name whose first piece is a vowel + l/r (Or|phe|us, Ol|ken, Al|ca|zaren, Ul|ku, Alt|is|ent)
fire: The opera retells how Orpheus went down to fetch his wife.
A well-known paper by Jones and Olken studies the effect of leaders on growth.
The new tower was designed by Paulo Alcazaren for a site near the bay.
The banquet was hosted by Ulku Karadag, who runs the family hotel.
The minutes were signed by Angela Altisent on behalf of the council.
In the play by Euripides, Alcestis agrees to die in place of her husband.
The young general Alcibiades persuaded the assembly to send the fleet.
The coalition led by Ehud Olmert lost its majority that spring.
quiet: The opera retells how Persephone went down to the world below.
A well-known paper by Jones and Franken studies the effect of leaders on growth.
The new tower was designed by Paulo Zamorano for a site near the bay.
The banquet was hosted by Demir Karadag, who runs the family hotel.
The minutes were signed by Angela Bartoszek on behalf of the council.
In the play by Euripides, Hecuba mourns the fall of her city.
The god of dreams, Morpheus, appears to the king in the form of a friend.
The coalition led by Thabo Mbeki lost its majority that spring.

notes: Card: peaks 'phe','ken','ca','ku','is' right after Or/Ol/Al/Ul/Alt. Probes: 6 such names 0.67-0.93, 'Robert Johnson' 0.01. Two fire items (Alcibiades, Olmert) and the Morpheus near miss are untried cases.
